LanguageData.EES.Scout.NotScoutedDesc: This stronghold's strength, facilities and defenses can only be revealed by scouting.\n\nSend a caravan to scout, or attack without scouting and the alert level will rise (direct-assault penalty).
LanguageData.EES.Scout.DedicatedNote: This outpost is generated by an external mod. EES only applies defenders, commander, and alert level; turrets, vault, and defenses are handled by that mod.

Psychic shrine detected: {0} ({1}).
A psychic drone will begin affecting your settlement in 3 days. Destroy the shrine to stop it immediately.

Jamming station detected: {0} ({1}).
In 3 days, scouting that faction's bases will become harder and comms interception and precision strikes will be blocked. Destroy the station to lift it.

LanguageData.EES.Set.RebuildWD.Tip: With World Domination loaded, rebuild convoys are disabled by default (to avoid overlapping WD ruins/resettlement). Enable this to use both.

LanguageData.EES.Traps.Cleared: [EES] Stronghold cleared — {0} hidden enemy trap(s) neutralized. Safe to loot.
LanguageData.EES.Cmd.Resurrect: [EES] The fanatic agitator resurrects {0} fallen defender(s)!
LanguageData.EES.Cmd.Rally: [EES] The fanatic agitator rallies {0} incapacitated defender(s) back to their feet!
LanguageData.EES.Cmd.ResearchCore: [EES] The research director's death yields a techprof subpersona core.
LanguageData.EES.BuyIntel.Label: Buy Intel
LanguageData.EES.BuyIntel.Desc: Consume one intel data core to remotely reveal this stronghold's information (no caravan, no risk).\n\nThe lowest-tier core that covers the target's tier is used first.
LanguageData.EES.BuyIntel.NoItem: No intel data core covering this tier (T{0}). Buy one from an exotic trader.
LanguageData.EES.BuyIntel.TooHigh: This tier cannot be bought with intel data cores (max T12).
LanguageData.EES.Gizmo.InfiltrateDesc:
Send an infiltration team ({1} of max 3) to sabotage enemy turrets (success {0}).

Primary stat = move speed, secondary = shooting+melee (sum of 40 = max), weighted 60:40. More members raise success (2 = +5%, 3 = +15%). With 4 or more you cannot sneak in.

On success: alert drops sharply + turrets permanently disabled. On failure: each participant is independently captured/killed and relations worsen (-25).

Note: only strongholds you have already scouted can be infiltrated.
LanguageData.EES.Gizmo.InfiltrateDescLocked:
Send an infiltration team ({0} of max 3) to sabotage enemy turrets.

Primary stat = move speed, secondary = shooting+melee (sum of 40 = max), weighted 60:40. More members raise success (2 = +5%, 3 = +15%). With 4 or more you cannot sneak in.

On success: alert drops sharply + turrets permanently disabled. On failure: each participant is independently captured/killed and relations worsen (-25).

Note: only strongholds you have already scouted can be infiltrated. The success chance is shown once scouting is done.

LanguageData.EES.Infil.AlreadyDone: This stronghold has already been infiltrated (cannot infiltrate again).

LanguageData.EES.DebugGizmo.RoleDesc: [God Mode] Directly pick this stronghold's role (affects facilities, theme buildings, loot, and commander chance). Takes effect next time you enter this base's map.
LanguageData.EES.Power.Cut: [EES] The stronghold's generators are destroyed — its powered turrets shut down.

These bases keep projecting a threat at your settlement until they are destroyed. Click an entry to jump to that base.
The owning faction can change through war or conquest. If it differs from the faction named in the original letter, the faction shown here is the current owner.
LanguageData.EES.Ransom.Intro: We hold your people. Pay the price and we will send them back.
LanguageData.EES.Ransom.Paid: Paid {1} silver in ransom. {0} is coming home.
LanguageData.EES.Set.Supply.Tip: Supply caravans headed for hostile strongholds periodically appear nearby. Intercept one to seize its cargo and temporarily weaken the destination stronghold.
LanguageData.EES.Set.SupplyLetter.Tip: Shows a letter when a supply caravan appears on the world map. When off, they appear silently and must be spotted on the world map yourself. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.No: Cannot intercept — it will arrive before you can catch it
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.Wait: Ambush ready — waiting for the supply caravan
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.Canceled: Interception canceled — the supply caravan will pass by without a fight.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.WorldWarAlly: Same side in the world war — cannot intercept
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.WorldWarNeutral: Neutral state in the world war — cannot intercept other factions' supply caravans
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.Overlap: Overlapping a base — wait until it moves clear
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Intercept.Ordered: Moving to the interception point — cutting off the supply caravan.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Letter.Text: A supply caravan of {0} is headed for {1}. Intercept it before it arrives to seize the cargo and temporarily weaken the destination stronghold.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Invaded.Text: An enemy supply caravan has entered your territory. Wipe out its escort to seize the cargo and weaken the destination stronghold.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Engaged.Text: You caught up with the supply caravan. Its escort is defending the cargo.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Missed: The supply caravan slipped away — interception canceled.
LanguageData.EES.Supply.Cut: {0}'s supply line is cut — its defenses are weakened for a while.
LanguageData.EES.Scout.SupplyCut: Supply cut — direct turrets -{0}, mortars -{1} applied ({2} remaining)
LanguageData.EES.Intel.NotScouted: Intel: not scouted (scout to reveal full intel)
LanguageData.EES.Set.PreventDeath.Tip: When on, scouts/infiltrators can never die on a failed scout or infiltration (0% death chance). The death chance is absorbed into capture/injury/escape (capture can still happen). While on, traders will not sell the "emergency escape device". Default: off.
LanguageData.EES.Set.ScoutUnlockHigh.Tip: When on, the scouting entry barrier on tier 8+ outposts is removed. Success chance never drops to 0% even with no research (minimum 6%). Applies to scouting, intercepts and precision strikes alike. Detection chance on failure is unchanged, and tier 7 and below plus late-game success chances stay the same. Default: off.
LanguageData.EES.Set.WDTierSync: Let EES generate World Domination settlements
LanguageData.EES.Set.WDTierSync.Tip: When World Domination is installed, EES takes over outpost generation and tiering for WD settlements. EES bases are generated instead of WD's KCSG layouts, and the tier is derived from each settlement's WD development (strength), mapped onto the EES tier scale (T1-13, within the faction's tech-era cap). World Domination's world simulation (war, expansion, raids) keeps working. Turn off to leave WD's original bases and tiers. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.TierAmmo.Tip: With CE integration on, the ammo loaded into garrison rifles and CE turrets is picked by stronghold tier. Low tiers mostly carry FMJ/HP; higher tiers shift toward AP, then incendiary, then HE. Pistols, SMGs, launchers etc. keep CE's default loadout. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.WealthScale.Tip: When on, your colony wealth slightly accelerates stronghold growth progress. Research remains the backbone of growth; wealth is only a minor boost. When off, wealth is ignored entirely. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.ResearchScale.Tip: When on, your research era (gates like Electricity, Machining, Fabrication) is the backbone of stronghold growth progress. When off, research is ignored — strongholds grow very slowly from elapsed days/wealth only, and scout success estimation also uses elapsed days only. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.AllowMortars.Tip: When off, no mortars are placed in strongholds (zero even if the base has a mortar battery facility). Scout tab / scout report estimates show zero as well. When on, bases with a mortar battery (T6+) get the per-tier mortar count. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.AlertSystem.Tip: Manages per-stronghold alert level (0-5). Attacking a base raises its alert and spreads it to nearby bases of the same faction; it decays naturally over time. Higher alert means bigger garrisons and ambushes (the "combat points per alert level" multiplier just below). When off, alert levels no longer rise. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.Scouting.Tip: Master toggle for scouting, infiltration and comms interception. When off, the scout/infiltrate commands disappear and the ambush penalty for attacking unscouted strongholds no longer triggers. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.Reinforcements.Tip: While you attack a stronghold, outside reinforcements arrive periodically as long as its comms console and commander are alive (interval/size via the sliders below). Destroy the console or kill the commander to stop them. When off, no reinforcements arrive. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.Commanders.Tip: High-tier strongholds get a commander (10 types — garrison-boosting auras, unique gear, keeps reinforcements coming while alive, etc.). When off, no commanders are generated. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.DisableBattlefield.Tip: When on, Battlefield outposts no longer appear. The Battlefield is a sustained multi-faction 4-way raid and is performance-heavy. Default = off (Battlefield appears).
LanguageData.EES.Set.CEIntegration.Tip: Master toggle for all EES Combat Extended integration — guaranteed garrison ammo, machine-gunner assignment, CE turret magazine loading and reserve ammo for manned turrets, CE ammo depot loot, CE reinforced walls/doors at high tiers, and more. Automatically inactive when CE is not loaded, regardless of this setting. Default: on.
LanguageData.EES.Set.DebugLog.Tip: Writes verbose diagnostic messages to the game log. Only enable when reporting a bug. Default: off.
LanguageData.EES.Set.Blacklist.Desc: Checked factions are excluded from all EES systems (tier, scouting/infiltration, commanders, alert level, ambush, loot, base generation). Only factions that found settlements are listed.
LanguageData.EES.Set.TurretBL.RaceDesc: Checked turrets will not be placed in that faction's bases. If all of a faction's turrets are checked, that faction uses vanilla turrets instead.
LanguageData.EES.Set.TurretBL.ModDesc: Checked turrets will not be placed in any base. Vanilla turrets are unaffected.

LanguageData.EES.Observer.CountdownDesc: The observer officer periodically designates one of your group as a target. The target is focus-fired by all enemies except gunners. Kill the commander (observer officer) to stop it.
LanguageData.EES.Observer.CountdownDescTarget: The observer officer has designated {0} as the target. All enemies except gunners focus-fire them. Kill the commander (observer officer) to stop it.

LanguageData.EES.Set.HVT.Tip: Third-party factions place bounties on commanders of hostile strongholds. Kill the commander or destroy the base within the deadline to claim one of three rewards.

Search the {1} outskirts and kill or capture them before then. If they escape alive, intel on your settlement will fall into enemy hands.
